text.p: Vastar Resources Inc said Monday it purchased Kerr-McGee Corp's interests in the Spider and Logansport fields in DeSoto Parish, La.

The $12.1 million acquisition includes net production of about 4.5 million cubic feet of natural gas per day, Vastar said. It estimates proven developed reserves of 16.8 billion cubic feet equivalent and proven undeveloped reserves of 8.0 billion cubic feet.
These properties are adjacent to existing Vastar production in the East Texas Basin and bring the company's total net production in the area to about 35 million cubic feet equivalent per day.

Vastar said it plans to start a drilling program immediately and expects to exploit the undeveloped reserves over the next few years. The program will target the Hosston formation, which is being successfully exploited by Vastar and others in the immediate area.
